author: Dr Ben Miles
description:
Scientists have developed autonomous microrobots smaller than a grain of salt that can swim using electrokinetic propulsion powered by light. These robots contain onboard computers and sensors, allowing them to make decisions and operate for months without external controls.

Source Article: https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/01/260105165815.htm
